verdict.rationale: Greptile documents several programmatic surfaces that mirror dashboard functions. `greptile onboard` does "the same setup the dashboard does" (org creation, repo connection, rules import). The MCP server lets agents fetch comments, apply fixes and manage patterns "instead of switching to GitHub or the Greptile dashboard." greptile.json overrides dashboard review settings, and the CLI accepts an API key. However, no public REST API or OpenAPI spec was found (all candidate paths 404), and some settings are documented only in the UI, such as Settings → Code Review → Default Coding Agents. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose API with an explicit UI-parity claim, programmatic coverage of org/admin settings, an OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
